presentation.label: SCALE / ROOT
presentation.summary: Keep pitch edits and chromatic trig keys in one of 24 scales with a selectable root.
presentation.overview: Scale Quantizer adds SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE to PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER. Pitch turns and parameter locks move through scale degrees, and chromatic trig keys snap to the chosen scale. ROOT transposes the scale and keyboard. SCALE OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
highlights: Pitch knob, parameter locks and chromatic keys follow the scale
usage: Open PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER and set SCALE. OFF preserves stock pitch behavior; choose a scale to constrain notes.
Set ROOT to the key you want. Pitch edits step by scale degree; chromatic keys snap to a degree and key 1 plays the root.
SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE persist through project save/reload and battery RAM. Synth polyphony and synth glide features require SYNTH MACHINE, which is outside this import.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: OFF restores stock pitch behavior; select a scale to constrain PTCH edits, locks and chromatic keys.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: Root of the scale and chromatic keyboard. Ignored with SCALE OFF.

controls.name: GLIDE
controls.doc: OFF or 1–127 slide time; the track LEG setting controls legato. Synth features require the separate SYNTH MACHINE module.

limitations: Sample pitch quantization works on Flex, Static and Pickup; RATE is not a semitone control.
Synth polyphony and synth-specific tuning/glide depend on SYNTH MACHINE, which is outside this catalog.
v2.9’s last fixes have emulator evidence; the earlier MKI result does not qualify the complete current pin.

storage.label: ROM footprint
storage.conditions: Upstream v2.9 record: 192-byte core, 45-byte key stub and 6-byte scale trampoline. DRAM code, grown menus and loader overhead are additional; this is not a new local assembly measurement.

access.location: PROJECT > CONTROL > SEQUENCER: SCALE, ROOT and GLIDE rows.
steps: On the MKII panel, press PROJ to open the project menu.
Use UP/DOWN to select CONTROL, then press RIGHT to enter its list.
Select SEQUENCER with UP/DOWN and press YES.
Scroll DOWN to SCALE and turn LEVEL to choose a scale. OFF restores stock pitch behavior.
Scroll to ROOT and turn LEVEL to select the key. GLIDE is the next row; its effect depends on the track’s LEG setting.
